# LabLink

> GenAI-powered campus laboratory resource-sharing platform: equipment discovery across departments, conflict-free slot booking, project-based access requests, faculty approvals and fair allocation of scarce equipment.

## Using the demo

- Open the site and choose a demo persona (student or faculty); no password is needed.
- Students: Discover equipment in plain language, book hourly slots, submit project requests.
- Faculty: review the approval queue, resolve scheduling conflicts, view utilisation.

## Source

- [README](https://github.com/potatoesareathing/lablink#readme): architecture, allocation algorithm, security, accessibility and tests.
